name: Chronicles from the Abyss
detailed_description:
Chronicles of the Abyss is a collection of 4, twisted Horror & Thriller stories where every choice drips with dread. It doesn't matter if you are playing alone, or with a friend. Making choices will effect your outcome. Be careful what you choose!




PERFECT FOR STREAMERS & CONTENT CREATORS:


With these 4 games, you can have your audience vote & choose what path to take, ultimately sealing your fate. Streamers will have engaged audiences all the way through to the very end!

Want to make short form videos & then have people vote on the course to take next episode? Leave a poll in the comments on your video & have them choose your next video outcome!



GENERAL FEATURES:


- Steam Achievements for each ending: That's a lot of achievements!

- High resolution images: Clean & crisp artwork so you can get immersed into the story.

- Available in 4 languages: English, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, & Simplified Chinese.

- Special Pages to unlock: Collect all the endings to unlock more lore.



ABOUT THE GAMES:


THE CLOUD:


The Cloud is a surreal analog horror experience that will leave you questioning reality. Bathed in unsettling artwork and realistic soundscapes, this game throws you into a world where the safety of your house twists into the bizarre.

Unravel the Mystery, One Choice at a Time:

Your experience with The Cloud is based on choices, each one a thread leading to a different fate. With a staggering 19 endings, your curiosity will lead you to see and do what no one else dared to.

Piece Together the Puzzle:

What is The Cloud?  The answers are scattered throughout the game, waiting to be discovered. Only by piecing together the fragments of information, sharing theories, and collaborating with others can the true nature of The Cloud be revealed.

Key Features:

  • 19 Unique Endings: Explore every possible outcome and discover the full scope of The Cloud's narrative.

  • Stunning Artwork: Immerse yourself in a visually captivating game.

  • Realistic Sound Design: we reccomend using headphones.

  • A Deep, Unsettling Mystery: Unravel the secrets behind The Cloud and piece together the fragments of its hidden story.

SEED:


What is happening to the Underwood Farm? Crops, once ordinary, now thrive under the suffocating darkness of a newly erected shed, their growth unnaturally accelerated. But at what cost?

You, an observant resident, discover a disturbing anomaly within a seemingly ripe tomato, setting you on a chilling quest for answers. 

Navigate the mystery making crucial choices that will determine your fate and the fate of the town.

Key Features:

  • 20 Unique Endings: Every choice matters, leading to diverse and unsettling conclusions.

  • Atmospheric Horror: Immerse yourself in a chilling medieval setting, where dread lurks in every shadow.

  • Intriguing Mystery: Unravel the secrets of Underwood Farm and the unsettling growth that plagues it.

  • Choice-Driven Narrative: Shape your own destiny through meaningful decisions that impact the story.

  • Story-Rich Experience: Delve into a world filled with lore, secrets, and unsettling revelations.

  • The Tomato: A single, odd tomato starts the whole adventure.

SPEAK, LORD:


Matthew 10:28 - “Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul.”

Is God truly there? Is God even real? 

These are some of the questions that face practicing Christians each day. 

Those who claim to hear the voice of God elate in worship. They spread the gospel 

& worship him. 

John 8:24: "I told you that you would die in your sins; if you do not believe that I am he, you will indeed die in your sins."

The father asks for PRAYER to prove your loyalty. But do you give it? Have you obeyed, and lived your life sinless?

Why does God forsake you? 

Was God even there all along?

Key Features:

  • An Analog Horror game about religion & the pursuit of answers: A chilling story about a false god, and a deciever of the devout.

  • 6 different endings to find: Every choice leads to a diverse and unsettling conclusion.

  • 3D Rendered Scenes: Speak, Lord uses 3D rendered scenes instead of traditional artwork to bring realistic looking visuals.

  • Analog Horror Effect: A time of the 90's. A VHS effect makes it feel as though you are watching banned footage.

HEADSHOT:


Something's not right. There's something under your bed... You're drawn to it, compelled to explore your surroundings and beyond.

What is going on inside this room?
What is going on beyond this room?
Can you remember yesterday?
Can you spot the clues that explain the situation you're in?

Key Features:

  • A Vivid, Unsettling World: Dive into a world of striking colors and a unique, disquieting art style.

  • Choices That Matter: Every decision you make branches the narrative, leading to one of 15 distinct endings.

  • A Fragmented Narrative: Piece together the truth exploring every possible path.

  • Surreal Horror: Experience a story that twists reality and plays with your expectations, leaving you questioning what's real.

supported_languages: English, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel G4560 or AMD FX series
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Integrated Graphics UHD 6000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard Audio
  • VR Support: n/a
  • Additional Notes: This game does not support 16:10 aspect ratio as to preserve the pixel art graphics
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel G4560 or AMD FX series
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GT 750 2GB or AMD Radeon HD 6450
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Onboard Audio
  • VR Support: n/a
  • Additional Notes: This game does not support 16:10 aspect ratio as to preserve the pixel art graphics

content_descriptors.notes: The content inside this game contains no sexual content at all. The topics include home intruders, self-defense, & religious topics such as loss of faith & descriptions of death. There are no depictions of drugs/alcohol/sexual abuse, suicide or other sensitive subjects like this.
